senses.gloss:
(इ,) धवि r. 1st cl. (धन्वति)
To go or move: this is considered sometimes as a Sautra root.

m. (-वः)
1 A husband.
2 A man.
3 A rogue, a cheat.
4 A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.)
E.
धू to make tremble, (children, &c.) affix अप्.

(उ) धावु r. 1st cl. (धावति-ते)
1 To go or move.
2 To run.
3 To cleanse.
4 To be clean or pure.
With अनु,
1 To know.
2 To run after.
With अभि prefixed,
To approach, to come before.
With आङ्,
To alight.
With परि,
To run fast.
With वि,
To shed or sprinkle.
With सम् and उग्र,
To run to meet.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 White.
2 Handsome, beautiful.
m. (-लः)
1 White, (the colour.)
2 A capital ox.
3 The Grislea tomentosa.
4 Camphor.
5 An inferior Rāga or mode of music.
n. (-लं)
White pepper.
f. (-ला or -ली)
A white cow, &c.
E.
धाव to be clean or pure, कलच् affix, and the radical vowel made short.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A goose.
2 The fortnight of the moon's increase.
E.
धवल, and पक्ष a wing or fortnight.

f. (-का)
Chalk.
E.
धवल white, मृत्तिका earth.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
White, whitened.
E.
धवल, and इतच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
White, made white.
E.
धवल, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Become white.
E.
धवल, and भूत become, च्चि aff.

n. (-लं)
The white esculent water lily.
E.
धवल white, and उत्पल a lotus.

m. (-कः)
Air, wind.
E.
धू to agitate, (the leaves of trees, &c.) and आणक Uṇādi aff.

n. (-त्रं)
A Pankhā or fan, made of antelope's skin, and used especially for blowing a sacrificial fire.
E.
धू to agitate, इच aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Running, going, swift, expeditious.
2 Cleaning, what cleans or cleanses.
E.
धाव to go, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्)
Running, going quickly.
E.
धाव to go, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Going, motion.
2 Cleansing, purifying.
f. (-निः) or (-नी)
A sort of creeping plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)
E.
धाव to go, to cleanse, affix ल्युट् or अनि fem. affix ङीप्.

f. (-का)
A prickly nightshade: see कण्टकारी.
E.
कन् added to धावनी, implying similitude.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Purified, clean, cleansed.
2 Gone, gone or run away.
3 Run to, advanced to or against.
E.
धाव to clean, affix क्त, with इट् augment, or without the augment धौत.
